segments.contextAfter: `validator`: A closure that you implement to validate the data to paste. SwiftUI calls this before it calls the `action` closure, and passes in an array of items to validate. Inspect the items, and return an array that includes only those from the input array that you consider valid. The array that you return from this closure becomes the input to the `action` closure. If you return an empty array, SwiftUI doesn’t call the `action` closure.
